citation: State of Tamil Nadu v. Venkatesh (2021) 3 SCC 567
reasoning_summary: Acquittal ordered as prosecution failed to prove mens rea beyond reasonable doubt. CCTV footage was unclear, no eyewitness to actual stabbing, and accused had no prior enmity. Benefit of doubt given to accused.

facts_established.actus_reus: Death occurred but perpetrator not conclusively identified
facts_established.mens_rea: Not established - no evidence of intention or knowledge
facts_established.chain_of_custody: Weak - no direct evidence linking accused to weapon
